114.DSCR:
Communications officer of $$フリーデン$$. Age 17.
Bright and easygoing by nature, she had become the mood-maker not only of the bridge but of all of $$フリーデン$$.
She was bound in deep friendship to $$エニル$$, whom she met during the journey, and her natural brightness was a major catalyst in unraveling $$エニル$$'s closed-off heart. However, her blunt way of speaking could sometimes hurt others, and once she touched on an emotional wound by making a flippant remark about $$ウィッツ$$'s photograph.
But that became the start of a gradual thaw between her and $$ウィッツ$$. And before the final battle, they had grown close enough that $$ウィッツ$$ gave her a ring, together with his feelings.
After the war ended, she visited his hometown together with $$ウィッツ$$.

115.DSCR:
Helmsman of $$フリーデン$$. Age 20.
Earnest and unassuming by nature, but his skill at the helm was first-rate, and he was indispensable to $$フリーデン$$. When the ship first went out into space, he even displayed a master's skill, steering the $$フリーデンⅡ$$ after merely skimming the manual.
While the ship was in port he also handled all sorts of odd jobs, and once stood guard as jailer when $$ガロード$$, who had broken into $$フリーデン$$, was put in the solitary cell.
After peace came, he was seen running the junk dealership '$$フリーデンⅢ$$' together with $$キッド$$, $$パーラ$$, and the others.

116.DSCR:
Chief mechanic of $$フリーデン$$.
Serving as chief at the young age of 12, the youngest of the crew, his mechanical skill and knowledge put adults to shame. Besides maintaining mobile suits, he was remarkably versatile, building a simulator for bit attacks and adjusting the combining mechanism of the $$Ｇファルコン$$.
He was always stockpiling useful-looking parts and ideas, and it was his handiwork that powered up each of the Gundams, starting with the $$ガンダムＸ$$ and including the $$エアマスター$$ and the $$レオパルド$$.
After $$フリーデン$$ had served its purpose, he started running the junk dealership '$$フリーデンⅢ$$' together with $$シンゴ$$, $$パーラ$$, and the mechanics under him.

117.DSCR:
Resident doctor of $$フリーデン$$. Age 36.
His ability as a doctor was extremely high, and he handled every kind of work, from internal medicine to surgery and even mental care. Being the oldest among the crew, he had deep experience and an adult's composure. He was also greatly trusted by $$ジャミル$$ and often served as a sounding board for $$ジャミル$$.
He was quite an avid reader, and once recited the contents of 'Lorelei' by the German poet Heine.
His hobby was billiards, and his skill there was also considerable; in a match against $$ロアビィ$$ with the usage fee of the relaxation room at stake, he won a brilliant victory. Later, when most of the crew went out shopping for supplies, he took the opportunity to try some secret training, and he panicked when $$サラ$$ and $$トニヤ$$ caught him at it, showing an unexpectedly childlike side.
After $$フリーデン$$ disbanded, he worked at a field hospital. He offered a cup to two soldiers who were at odds and arguing, and told them, 'Most problems get settled in your own heart while you drink a single cup of coffee. All that's left is whether you can carry it out.' He showed an adult's composure to the very end.

118.DSCR:
A notorious freelance mobile suit pilot. The elder of the Frost brothers. Age 19.
Being a freelance mobile suit pilot was only a cover; in truth he was an agent belonging to the intelligence agency of the $$新連邦軍$$.
He had a telepathic ability called '$$ツインズ・シンクロニティ$$' that let him communicate only with his fraternal twin younger brother $$オルバ$$, without exchanging a word. With it they could avoid danger for each other and carry out operations even at places far apart. Yet even with such an ability, it was not recognized in the face of $$ニュータイプ$$ supremacism, and he was branded '$$カテゴリーＦ$$.' As a result, he came to hate $$ニュータイプ$$s and the whole world that acknowledged their existence.
He was cruel and ruthless by nature, choosing any means to reach his goal. Those who were the targets of his own revenge, or who were no longer of use, he killed one after another, sometimes with his beloved $$ガンダムヴァサーゴ$$, sometimes by aiming a gun at them directly. He was also always cool and composed, able to judge his surroundings and the state of the battle accurately, and he repeatedly admonished $$オルバ$$, who lost sight of the situation when the blood rushed to his head.
After the fighting ended, in a corner of a certain town, he watched $$ガロード$$ and $$ティファ$$ set out on their journey while $$オルバ$$ pushed his wheelchair.

119.DSCR:
The younger of the Frost brothers, notorious freelance mobile suit pilots. Age 19.
Being a freelance mobile suit pilot was only a cover; in truth he was an agent belonging to the intelligence agency of the $$新連邦軍$$.
He had a telepathic ability called '$$ツインズ・シンクロニティ$$' that let him communicate only with his fraternal twin older brother $$シャギア$$, without exchanging a word. With it they could avoid danger for each other and carry out operations even at places far apart. Yet even with such an ability, it was not recognized in the face of $$ニュータイプ$$ supremacism, and he was branded '$$カテゴリーＦ$$.' As a result, he came to hate $$ニュータイプ$$s and the whole world that acknowledged their existence.
He was cold and heartless by nature, choosing any means to reach his goal. But that was only his outward face; beneath his refined features he hid a fury beyond anything his looks would suggest. He was often reined in by $$シャギア$$ when the blood rushed to his head and he lost sight of the situation.
After the war, in a corner of a certain town, there was the sight of him from behind, pushing $$シャギア$$'s wheelchair as he watched $$ガロード$$ and $$ティファ$$ set out on their journey.

120.DSCR:
A boy who served as leader of the vigilante corps of the provincial city $$フォートセバーン$$. Age 15.
An artificial $$ニュータイプ$$ so superb that Mayor $$ノモア$$ said of him, 'He is my finest masterpiece.' He himself had absolute confidence in his own power, and the ability to match it.
Though he drove off the $$ガンダムＸ$$ with his beloved $$ベルティゴ$$, the existence of $$ティファ$$, a natural $$ニュータイプ$$ who was not supposed to exist, and then his defeat at the hands of the revived $$ガロード$$, made him lose his reason for existing. Finally, as he was about to take his own life, he was saved by $$ガロード$$, and that became the trigger for opening his heart.
After that, his power was exploited, and he destroyed the city with the giant mobile armor $$パトゥーリア$$. After he was freed from it by $$ガロード$$ and the others, he resolved to devote himself to rebuilding the city as atonement.
Later, as the commander of a unit of an anti-$$新連邦$$ organization, he saved the crew of $$フリーデン$$ from peril. Moreover, when they needed a means to go up into space, he even provided a space battleship.

121.DSCR:
An important $$地球連邦#awgx$$ stronghold built on the side of the Moon that faces the Earth.
An unmanned facility running on solar power, it can theoretically keep supplying massive, inexhaustible energy. Because it controls the transmission facility for the microwaves needed to fire the $$サテライトキャノン$$, seizing control of $$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#pilot$$ means seizing control of the $$サテライトキャノン$$. The facility's surroundings are guarded by powerful bit mobile suits for the defense of $$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#pilot$$, making entry by force extremely difficult.
In reality it is the $$ファーストニュータイプ$$, genetically broken down at the nano level and turned into a biological system. Because of this, the will of the incorporated $$ファーストニュータイプ$$ remains, and it demonstrated abilities such as sensing other $$ニュータイプ$$s and moving the bit mobile suits by way of the $$フラッシュシステム$$.
It invited the crew of $$フリーデン$$ and the leaders of both camps, the $$宇宙革命軍$$ and the $$新地球連邦軍#awgx$$, who were scheming to seize $$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#pilot$$, into the facility, and before them the $$ファーストニュータイプ$$ itself described $$ニュータイプ$$s as 'an illusion people held about a kind of psychic,' denying their existence.

122.DSCR:
A boy of the $$ムーンレィス$$ who pilots the $$∀ガンダム#robot$$. Age 17.
Together with $$キース$$ and $$フラン$$, he descended to Earth two years earlier as an advance survey member of the Earth return operation. Because the $$ハイム$$ sisters had saved him when he was drowning in a river at that time, he came to work in the $$ハイム$$ family's mine, and in time became a servant.
Gentle by nature and averse to conflict, he reluctantly joined the $$イングレッサ・ミリシャ$$ in order to stop the war between the Moon and the Earth.
Contrary to that nature, he excelled at piloting mobile suits, and combined with the performance of the $$∀ガンダム#robot$$, he was active as a core of the $$ミリシャ$$. Even in scenes where he held a weapon in person, he fought bravely without flinching, showing a manly side.
Like all the other $$ムーンレィス$$, he was devoted to $$ディアナ$$, and his actions were always based first of all on $$ディアナ$$.
After the settlement with $$ギンガナム$$, he took a step into a new life together with $$ディアナ$$, who had stayed on Earth after swapping places with $$キエル$$.

123.DSCR:
Head of the Soriel family that rules the Moon, and Queen of the $$ムーンレィス$$.
She was the spiritual anchor of the $$ムーンレィス$$ and commanded immense trust and reverence.
Her official age was 19, but because she had repeated artificial hibernation many times, several hundred years seem to have passed since her birth. During that time she visited Earth several times, and those experiences became a major motive for the return to Earth.
By chance she met $$キエル$$, who has an identical appearance, and out of a mischievous impulse they swapped places, but she lost the chance to return to normal. However, while living among the people of Earth as $$キエル$$, she came to touch their hearts, and learned about what true peace is and how to achieve it.
And at last she came to know that the one they truly had to fight was $$アグリッパ$$.
After defeating $$アグリッパ$$ and $$ギンガナム$$, she remained on Earth, and together with $$ロラン$$ she gained a happy life of living surrounded by nature.

124.DSCR:
The eldest daughter of the $$ハイム$$ family, where $$ロラン$$ worked as a servant. Age 17.
Not bound by feudal social conventions, she believed that women too should step out into the real world, and served as $$グエン$$'s assistant.
She looked so much like the Moon's queen $$ディアナ$$ that even family could not tell them apart. At $$ディアナ$$'s suggestion they swapped places half in play, and she missed the timing to switch back, ending up actually placed in the queen's position.
But that became the catalyst; she learned that the $$ムーンレィス$$ were no different from Earthlings, and came to strive to understand $$ディアナ$$'s thinking and to consider what she herself should do.
$$ハリー$$, who had been the very first to notice the swap, guarded her at the risk of his life, and as they shared the secret, she came to have feelings for him. The way she confessed that love was that of a girl her age.
After peace was restored, she swapped places with $$ディアナ$$ again and, before the $$ムーンレィス$$, called herself $$ディアナ$$.

125.DSCR:
The second daughter of the $$ハイム$$ family, where $$ロラン$$ worked as a servant. Age 15.
She was competitive, spirited, and tomboyish. Though she was drawn to $$ロラン$$, their respective positions and her temperament kept her from being honest.
To avenge her father, who had died in an attack by the $$ディアナ・カウンター$$, she volunteered for the $$イングレッサ・ミリシャ$$ and became a pilot of the $$カプル$$. Because of that, she was at first consumed with hatred of the $$ムーンレィス$$.
But after learning who $$ロラン$$ really was, and going through the incident with $$ギャバン$$, who loved her and even proposed to her, she grew greatly as a person.
She exchanged a farewell kiss in tears with $$ロラン$$, who chose to go with $$ディアナ$$.

126.DSCR:
A girl born into a family of airplane makers going back to her grandfather's generation, who herself flew the skies as an airplane pilot. Age 18.
She belonged to the airplane corps of the $$イングレッサ・ミリシャ$$ and fought from the outbreak of the war. She and $$ソシエ$$ were close enough to be called best friends, and after the $$カプル$$ was unearthed they often rode it into battle together.
When they went up to the Moon, she had made friends with a boy soldier of the $$ディアナ・カウンター$$, and sortied together with him in a $$ウァッド$$.

127.DSCR:
Commander of $$ディアナ$$'s Royal Guard. Age 18. His rank was lieutenant, and he was later promoted to captain.
Cool and intellectual by nature, but his excessive earnestness also gave him an inflexible side.
He had sworn absolute loyalty to $$ディアナ$$, and his devotion was so famous that even an ordinary female soldier knew of it. He was also the first to notice that $$ディアナ$$ and $$キエル$$ had swapped places, but he continued to serve without changing his attitude, and protected $$キエル$$.
He always wore red sunglasses that doubled as night-vision goggles, and 'to hide my gaze when I look at any woman other than $$ディアナ$$' was his own explanation. He did not take them off even when he kissed $$キエル$$, who had feelings for him, but it seems this never put $$キエル$$ off.
His skill in piloting his gold custom-made $$スモー$$ was superb. At the $$冬の宮殿$$, he took on the $$マヒロー$$ squad led by $$スエッソン$$ with a single unit and finished them off in seconds, which shows the extent of his ability.
After the fight with $$ギンガナム$$, at the side of $$キエル$$, who swapped places with $$ディアナ$$ again and crossed over to the Moon, there was $$ハリー$$, unchanged from before.

128.DSCR:
A second lieutenant of the $$ディアナ・カウンター$$.
She descended to Earth as the pilot of a $$ウォドム$$ under $$フィル$$. Her interception of the $$ミリシャ$$'s airplane corps became the start of the long war between Earth and the Moon.
She was prone to tears, crying at every turn, and her tearfulness was even made the subtitle of episode 31.
She seems to have been in a romantic relationship with her superior $$フィル$$, and followed him when he raised the banner of revolt against $$ディアナ$$. But deep in her heart her loyalty to the queen remained rooted, and when $$ディアナ$$ returned, she shed tears of joy all the same.
After all the fighting was over, she was seen taking on the $$マウンテンサイクル$$ together with $$シド$$, perhaps having become $$シド$$'s apprentice.

129.DSCR:
Grandson of the lord of $$イングレッサ$$ and a central figure of the $$イングレッサ・ミリシャ$$. Age 19.
Though raised as a pampered young master, he did not seem sheltered from the world; he showed a shrewdness that used anything that could be used, and outstanding talent in negotiation, political power, and judgment, all of which were honed further in battle.
Even when confronted with the Moon's overwhelming technological power, he did not become crushed; on the contrary, he secretly planned to bring about an industrial revolution with that technology. And even when $$イングレッサ$$ fell and he lost his power, he resolved to claw his way back up, showing that he was also a resilient man of ambition.
He had a strong fixation on $$ロラン$$, calling him '$$ローラ$$' and making him dress as a woman. Even when he betrayed $$ディアナ$$, he tried to bring $$ロラン$$ alone over to his side.
In the epilogue, he was seen going to $$ガリア$$ with $$メリーベル$$, whom he had saved with his own hands.

130.DSCR:
A girl said to be $$ギンガナム$$'s puppet. She came from the lowest stratum of the Moon, and had a past of being picked up by $$ギンガナム$$.
Her appearance, with an outlandish outfit that doubles as a space suit, large earmuffs, eye markings, and bells on her head, and her lightness of body, such as doing handstands even on Earth, where gravity is six times that of the Moon, call a clown to mind.
She liked to be near capable people who were fun to tease, such as $$ギンガナム$$ and $$グエン$$. And she threw remarks at them that seemed to incite war.
She had skill in piloting mobile suits that no one would imagine from such behavior, and handled the $$バンデット$$ like her own limbs.
In the epilogue she was acting together with $$グエン$$, and it was then that her true face was revealed for the first time.

131.DSCR:
The thirteenth and youngest daughter of Duke $$ボルジャーノ$$, lord of $$ルジャーナ$$.
Selfish and sheltered by nature, her carefree failure to understand war was very much that of a young lady. But she had extraordinary insight into things and powers of observation in judging people's true nature.
She had known $$グエン$$ since childhood, and was seen harassing $$キエル$$ ($$ディアナ$$) for getting close to him. However, she eventually came to admire $$キエル$$ for serving as Moon queen in place of $$ディアナ$$, and offered to become friends.
When $$グエン$$ betrayed them, she did not seem shaken in the least, and on the contrary showed a strong core, trying to stop his actions.

132.DSCR:
A former sergeant of the $$ディアナ・カウンター$$.
After being defeated by $$ロラン$$, he took holy orders and wandered from place to place, but when he saw the light of the $$月光蝶$$ released by $$メリーベル$$'s $$∀ガンダム#robot$$, he remembered his mission. He then went to $$ディアナ$$, and when he was permitted to return to the army and to strike down the $$ターンタイプ$$ $$ガンダム$$, he burst into tears, overcome with emotion.
He had his $$カプル$$ repainted in his own colors, and his unrestrained ways, which left those around him exasperated, were as strong as ever. But his skill had not declined, and he pulled off aerial combat in the $$カプル$$, which he should have been unused to, and played an active role that overwhelmed the $$マヒロー$$ force.
When even the $$ターンＸ$$ then activated the $$月光蝶$$, he deliberately took the fuel from the $$カプル$$ of $$ソシエ$$ and $$メシェー$$ to leave the two stranded away from the battlefield, and went alone to certain death and fell.

136.DSCR:
A mobile suit pilot belonging to the $$ミネルバ$$.
Always calm and excellent at judging situations, he was a capable pilot who surpassed even his peers $$シン$$ and $$ルナマリア$$ in mobile suit piloting skill.
He admired $$デュランダル$$ like a parent, and trusted him so much that in front of him his personality turned into that of an innocent boy.
For that reason he regarded the $$アークエンジェル$$, which did not follow $$デュランダル$$, as an enemy, and deepened his conflict with $$アスラン$$, who could not cast off his past ties to them.
Eventually, when $$アスラン$$ tried to flee $$ザフト$$, he pulled the trigger without hesitation, meaning to shoot down $$アスラン$$ along with $$メイリン$$, who had helped him. When that failed, he immediately boarded the $$レジェンドガンダム$$ and gave chase.
Like $$ラウ・ル・クルーゼ$$, who died in the previous war, he is a clone of $$アル・ダ・フラガ$$, and shares the same trait of short telomeres (the part related to the lifespan of genes), having a body that cannot live long.
In the final battle, he lost his fight with $$キラ$$, and his mobile suit was heavily damaged. He barely made it to $$デュランダル$$ inside $$メサイア$$, but for the 'future' that $$キラ$$ spoke of, he shot $$デュランダル$$, whom he revered without end. At the last, held by $$タリア$$, he wept at finding someone who let him feel what a mother was for the first time, and was engulfed by the explosion.

proofread.reason: addition: 'the' before a person's name made Durandal read as a thing; 敬愛して止まないデュランダル = Durandal, whom he revered without end (name token untouched)

137.DSCR:
One of the key figures who brought the previous war to an end, he is a heroic figure whose name is known to virtually everyone in $$プラント$$. 18 years old.
After the war he defected to $$オーブ$$, serving as bodyguard to his lover $$カガリ$$. But faced with the outbreak of a new war, he keenly felt his own helplessness. Approached by $$デュランダル$$ in such a state, he bid farewell to $$カガリ$$ and returned to $$ザフト$$, becoming a member of the special forces unit $$ＦＡＩＴＨ$$.
Piloting the $$セイバーガンダム$$ entrusted to him upon his return, he serves aboard the $$ミネルバ$$, but eventually comes into conflict with his close friend $$キラ$$ over a difference in outlook.
Though initially sympathetic to $$デュランダル$$'s ideals, he gradually grows suspicious after learning of the suspected assassination attempt on $$ラクス$$, the use of the impostor $$ミーア$$, and the order to attack the $$アークエンジェル$$, whose cause should have been the same as his own.
He later deserts $$ザフト$$ and once again fights alongside $$キラ$$ and the others, standing against $$デュランダル$$'s proposed '$$デスティニープラン$$.'
During the final battle, he tries to persuade $$シン$$, who remains loyal to $$デュランダル$$, to stop fighting, but fails. When the deranged $$シン$$ turns to attack even $$ルナマリア$$, who had stepped in to stop him, $$アスラン$$ awakens SEED and shoots him down.

145.DSCR:
Captain of the $$アークエンジェル$$. Age 28.
For convenience, her rank was given as the Major she held in her days with the $$地球連合$$ forces, but after she formally became a member of the $$オーブ$$ military, her rank became Colonel.
In the previous war she originally belonged to the $$地球連合$$ forces, but came to doubt the military's actions and defected partway through. As a third force, she became the driving force that led the previous war to its end. She sometimes made cold decisions, but at heart she was a kind woman who watched over her young crew like a mother.
After the war she went to $$オーブ$$ with $$キラ$$, $$バルトフェルド$$, $$ラクス$$, and the others she had fought alongside, and herself worked in the shipbuilding section of the $$モルゲンレーテ$$ company. Just as she was considering emigrating to $$プラント$$, she was attacked by a special forces unit plotting to assassinate $$ラクス$$, but narrowly fended them off. That incident led her to resolve to launch the $$アークエンジェル$$ once more, for the sake of a world again falling into turmoil.
In the midst of the fighting in Berlin, she was reunited with her lover $$ムウ$$, who was supposed to have died protecting the $$アークエンジェル$$ in the previous war, but he had lost all his memories. In her heartache she told him to leave the ship, but $$ムウ$$, feeling that something was nagging at his heart, came back, and the two gradually opened their hearts to each other.

146.DSCR:
Mobile suit pilot of the $$アークエンジェル$$. His rank is Colonel.
In the Second Battle of $$ヤキン・ドゥーエ$$, he went missing after protecting the $$アークエンジェル$$. After that, having lost his memory, he called himself '$$ネオ・ロアノーク$$,' wore a mask, and had become a soldier of the $$地球連合$$ forces.
When he was shot down by $$キラ$$ in Berlin, his mask came off and his true face was revealed.
Afterward he was aboard the $$アークエンジェル$$ as a prisoner, but was freed by $$マリュー$$, who had been his lover. However, from the faint traces of his past memories and fragments of his feelings for $$マリュー$$, he resolved to return to the ship and fight together.
Later, when he was formally incorporated into the $$オーブ$$ military, he became the pilot of the $$アカツキ$$ in place of $$カガリ$$, who had to remain on Earth, and scored many great victories.
In the battle over $$メサイア$$, by coincidence the same situation as when he lost his memory was recreated, and he regained his memories and made a complete recovery.

147.DSCR:
An $$エクステンデッド$$ of the $$地球連合$$ forces' special forces unit $$ファントムペイン$$. She seized the $$ガイアガンダム$$ from $$ザフト$$ and became its pilot.
To suppress their runaway behavior, the $$エクステンデッド$$s like her are given a verbal safety device called the '$$ブロックワード$$.' The moment they hear that word, they become confused and fall into a state of self-loss. In $$ステラ$$'s case, the word 'death' is the one, and she repeatedly heard it and fell into a confused state.
Compared with her teammates $$スティング$$ and $$アウル$$, she was the most mentally unstable. Usually she was timid and meek, but in combat she revealed a savage destructive impulse.
Reacting to $$アウル$$'s words 'Mom is going to die,' she sortied alone as if to deny them. She was beaten back and taken prisoner by the $$ミネルバ$$, but escaped trouble through the actions of $$シン$$, whom she already knew. She was returned on the condition that she would not be drawn into battle from then on, but no peaceful time came to her.
Before long she was adjusted once more, and with her memories lost was made the pilot of the $$デストロイガンダム$$, and with overwhelming destructive power burned the city of Berlin, its residents, and the garrison to the last. Though she briefly regained her calm through the persuasion of $$シン$$, who rushed to the scene, she became confused on seeing the $$フリーダムガンダム$$ come into view. As she was about to fire beams as though to sweep everything away, she was stopped by $$キラ$$ and was engulfed by the explosion of the cockpit.
At her final moment she regained her memories and smiled, and fell into eternal sleep as $$シン$$ watched over her.

148.DSCR:
Executive officer of the $$ザフト$$'s newly built ship $$ミネルバ$$. Age 26.
Timid, restless, and prone to getting carried away, he was often scolded by Captain $$タリア$$.
During the final battle at $$メサイア$$, when the $$ミネルバ$$ became unable to fight, he was entrusted with the $$ミネルバ$$ crew by $$タリア$$, who was heading to $$デュランダル$$. By then his unreliability was already gone, and he sent $$タリア$$ off with a salute.

149.DSCR:
A $$ガンダムマイスター$$ of $$ソレスタルビーイング$$.
His real name is $$ソラン・イブラヒム$$. 23 years old.
He was raised amid conflict from childhood, active as an anti-government guerrilla. Because of this, though he hates conflict, he is aware that he can only truly live while fighting, and he joins $$ソレスタルビーイング$$, which advocates 'the eradication of conflict through armed force.'
Owing partly to his background, he was initially quiet and rarely showed emotion, and there were several occasions when he acted on his own judgment. But he held the ideal $$ソレスタルビーイング$$ advocated, the eradication of war, more firmly in his heart than anyone, and as he continued to fight he gradually became able to show consideration for his comrades and awareness of those around him.
Even after $$ソレスタルビーイング$$ was crushed following its defeat by the $$国連$$ forces, he alone continued fighting in the half-destroyed $$ガンダムエクシア$$, but he later rejoined the $$プトレマイオス２$$ and came to pilot the $$ダブルオーガンダム$$ equipped with the $$ツインドライヴ$$.
He was initially dismissive of $$マリナ$$'s single-minded devotion to peace, which he encountered in the course of the fighting, but eventually a change appears in his heart, and before facing the final battle against the $$国連$$ forces he is seen sending $$マリナ$$ an email, showing that he cared about her more than a little.
He is reunited with $$マリナ$$ after she loses her country, but when $$ミレイナ$$ asks if the two are a couple, he immediately denies it, showing their relationship is not romantic in nature.
Continuing to fight in the $$ダブルオーライザー$$, formed by combining with the $$オーライザー$$ piloted by $$沙慈$$, he awakens as an $$イノベイター$$ through the massive quantities of GN particles produced by the $$ツインドライヴ$$. With his years of combat experience, the machine's performance, and his $$イノベイター$$ abilities such as $$脳量子波$$, he achieves tremendous results in battle.
Against $$リボンズ$$, the source of it all and the one who once saved his life, he wages a fierce battle in the $$ダブルオーライザー$$ and later the $$ガンダムエクシアリペアⅡ$$, and finally achieves victory over him.
Even after the conflict with the $$イノベイド$$s is settled, he continues to fight as part of $$ソレスタルビーイング$$ for the sake of the changing world.

His real name is $$ソラン・イブラヒム$$. 23 years old.
He was raised amid conflict from childhood, active as an anti-government guerrilla. Because of this, though he hates conflict, he is aware that he can only truly live while fighting, and he joins $$ソレスタルビーイング$$, which advocates 'the eradication of conflict through armed force.'
Owing partly to his background, he was initially quiet and rarely showed emotion, and there were several occasions when he acted on his own judgment. But he held the ideal $$ソレスタルビーイング$$ advocated, the eradication of war, more firmly in his heart than anyone, and as he continued to fight he gradually became able to show consideration for his comrades and awareness of those around him.
Even after $$ソレスタルビーイング$$ was crushed following its defeat by the $$国連$$ forces, he alone continued fighting in the half-destroyed $$ガンダムエクシア$$, but he later rejoined the $$プトレマイオス２$$ and came to pilot the $$ダブルオーガンダム$$ equipped with the $$ツインドライヴ$$.
He was initially dismissive of $$マリナ$$'s single-minded devotion to peace, which he encountered in the course of the fighting, but eventually a change appears in his heart, and before facing the final battle against the $$国連$$ forces he is seen sending $$マリナ$$ an email, showing that he cared about her more than a little.
He is reunited with $$マリナ$$ after she loses her country, but when $$ミレイナ$$ asks if the two are a couple, he immediately denies it, showing their relationship is not romantic in nature.
Continuing to fight in the $$ダブルオーライザー$$, formed by combining with the $$オーライザー$$ piloted by $$沙慈$$, he awakens as an $$イノベイター$$ through the massive quantities of GN particles produced by the $$ツインドライヴ$$. With his years of combat experience, the machine's performance, and his $$イノベイター$$ abilities such as $$脳量子波$$, he achieves tremendous results in battle.
Against $$リボンズ$$, the source of it all and the one who once saved his life, he wages a fierce battle in the $$ダブルオーライザー$$ and later the $$ガンダムエクシアリペアⅡ$$, and finally achieves victory over him.
Even after the conflict with the $$イノベイド$$s is settled, he continues to fight as part of $$ソレスタルビーイング$$ for the sake of the changing world.
When he came into contact with the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$, he fell into a coma under the flood of massive information pouring into him, but woke up in the midst of the final battle. By activating the $$クアンタム・バースト$$ at the center of the giant $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$, he reconciled the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ with humanity, and himself headed for the home planet of the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ together with $$ティエリア$$.
Fifty years after the final battle, through dialogue with the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$, he returned to Earth as a being combining the characteristics of both the $$イノベイター$$s and the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$, and he and the aged $$マリナ$$ came to understand each other.

150.DSCR:
A $$ガンダムマイスター$$ of $$ソレスタルビーイング$$.
The twin younger brother of the previous $$ロックオン$$, $$ニール・ディランディ$$, who was killed in battle against the $$国連$$ forces. His real name is $$ライル・ディランディ$$. 31 years old.
He pilots the $$ガンダムサバーニャ$$.
His target acquisition ability is no less than his brother's, and he displays sniping skill worthy of carrying on the name $$ロックオン$$.

He does not harbor the same degree of anger toward the terrorists who took his parents and sister as his brother did. This stems from his belief that one should live looking to the future rather than the past, and by nature he is thoroughly forward-looking, outwardly appearing to have little attachment to things.

He also grows close to $$アニュー$$, who joined $$ソレスタルビーイング$$ around the same time as him, but loses her, an $$イノベイド$$, in the course of battle.

Even after the fight against the $$イノベイド$$s ends, he vows, facing the graves of his family and $$アニュー$$, to keep fighting as a $$ガンダムマイスター$$, and continues his activities as part of $$ソレスタルビーイング$$.

153.DSCR:
A $$ガンダムマイスター$$ of $$ソレスタルビーイング$$. 26 years old.
He pilots the $$ガンダムハルート$$.
He has heterochromia, with a blue left eye and a golden right eye.
Normally reserved and mild-mannered, he would avoid combat entirely if he could.

After the war ended, regretting the many lives he had taken in it, he leaves $$ソレスタルビーイング$$ together with $$マリー$$ and undertakes a pilgrimage.

157.DSCR:
A $$ガンダムマイスター$$ belonging to $$ソレスタルビーイング$$.
He is one of the $$イノベイド$$s, artificial beings created in imitation of the $$イノベイター$$s, the evolved form of humanity.
At first he was fixated on carrying out the missions presented by $$ヴェーダ$$, and strongly disliked letting personal feelings interfere. But he is deeply influenced by $$ロックオン$$, who showed concern for him, and gradually begins to show a more human side. When $$ロックオン$$ dies, he grieves and even vows revenge.
From then on, though his calm, composed impression remains unchanged, he begins in his own way to act in ways that show trust in his comrades, and to coordinate more with those around him.
Eventually, he is approached by the $$イノベイド$$s, beings of the same kind as himself, but he judges them to be a distortion of the world. He refuses their invitation and resolves to fight them as a human being.
In the battle against the $$イノベイド$$s, he loses his physical body to a bullet from $$リボンズ$$, but his being continues to live on within $$ヴェーダ$$ as data without physical form.
After the war, though not directly involved with $$ソレスタルビーイング$$, he quietly develops the $$ラファエルガンダム$$ aboard the $$宇宙航行母艦ソレスタルビーイング$$, watching over his comrades' activities, but joined them with a new body in their moment of crisis.

167.DSCR:
A commanding officer of the $$地球連邦軍#00$$. Her rank is Brigadier General. 39 years old.
She was formerly an operations commander for the $$ＡＥＵ$$, and holds a qualification as a tactical forecaster. She never neglects detailed situational analysis during operations, and always issues precise orders, earning the deep trust of her subordinates.
She and $$スメラギ$$ were acquaintances from their student days, and were already rivals as tactical forecasters back then.

Her subordinate $$パトリック・コーラサワー$$ holds feelings toward her that go beyond the respect due a superior officer; at first she could only be exasperated by his rashness, but she gradually found herself wryly smiling at his easygoing nature, and came to see him as someone she could not simply ignore.
After the fighting against the $$イノベイド$$s ended, she accepted the confession of $$コーラサワー$$, who had risked his life to save her, and married him.
